content: {"action":"appeal_with_necessity","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and the payer’s 14-day retroauthorization window has closed. Peer-to-peer review is unavailable, while a formal appeal is permitted with the denial on file and can argue medical necessity using the clinic documentation. Resubmission would not correct the authorization defect, and billing the patient is not appropriate at this stage."}
